questions.question: Who beat Jeremiah and put him in the stocks in chapter 20?
How did Jeremiah describe God's word within him when he tried to stop speaking?
options: Like a very heavy stone that he longed at last to set down
Like a fading dream that had faded away by the early morning
Like a fire shut up in his bones that he could not hold in
Like a sweet song within him that he could not ever stop singing
questions.answer: Like a fire shut up in his bones that he could not hold in

questions.question: Jeremiah laments his birth in this chapter, cursing the day he was born.
